answers.d01: 似然回答“如果假设是真的，眼前这批数据有多符合它”，不是“假设为真的概率”。例如两枚硬币中，假设A正面率为0.8；连续投10次出现8次正面，则似然是：在A成立时出现这批结果的可能性。后验概率回答“看到数据后，假设为真的概率是多少”。它还要结合先验概率：后验∝似然×先验。先验表示看数据前对假设的相信程度；似然提供数据证据。数据相同，先验不同，后验也可能不同。
answers.d02: 总体方差衡量“所有数据离总体平均数有多分散”。做法是：每个数减去总体平均数，得到偏差；把偏差平方，避免正负抵消并突出较大偏差；再把这些平方偏差相加，除以数据总数N。例：总体为1、3、5，平均数是3，偏差为−2、0、2，平方为4、0、4，所以总体方差=(4+0+4)/3=8/3。它的单位是原单位的平方；方差越大，数据通常越分散。这里除以N，因为手里的数据就是要描述的整个总体。
answers.d03: 正反馈是“变化产生的结果，又推动原变化继续发生”。例如麦克风靠近音箱时，声音被麦克风收回、放大，再从音箱播放；更大的声音再次被收回，于是声音越来越大。数学上可理解为每轮都乘以大于1的放大因子。它不等于好事，因为“正”表示方向与原变化相同，不表示价值好坏。股价上涨引发追涨、价格继续上涨，也是正反馈；但当资源、需求或系统容量达到限制后，放大可能停止，甚至转为崩溃。
answers.d04: Opportunity cost is the value of the best alternative you give up when making a choice. Suppose you have a free afternoon and choose to work a paid shift for $60. Your opportunity cost is not every other possible activity; it is the most valuable alternative you would realistically have chosen—perhaps spending that afternoon with a friend or resting. The $60 is the benefit of your choice, while the forgone alternative is its opportunity cost. If your alternatives change, the cost changes too. Choosing to rest can also have an opportunity cost, such as the wages or study time you give up.
answers.d05: 设患病率为1%，检测灵敏度为99%，假阳性率为5%。随机检测10000人：约100人患病，其中99人阳性；9900人未患病，其中约495人也会假阳性。因此阳性者约594人，真正患病的约99人，阳性后患病概率约为99/594≈16.7%。贝叶斯公式就是：P(病|阳性)=P(阳性|病)P(病)/P(阳性)。关键在于阳性结果不仅来自患病者，也来自大量未患病者；所以检测准确不等于阳性者几乎一定患病。
answers.d06: Cache invalidation means deciding when cached data is no longer trustworthy and should be refreshed or removed. Suppose a web app caches a user’s profile for five minutes. If the user changes their name, the cache may still show the old name until it expires. Common strategies are time-based expiration, explicitly deleting or updating the cache after a write, and versioning keys. Each trades freshness against speed and complexity. The core difficulty is that the database and cache hold copies of the same fact: every update path must define which copy changes first and what happens if the operation fails halfway.
answers.d07: 相关表示两个量一起变化，因果表示一个量的变化会导致另一个量变化。例如夏天冰淇淋销量上升，同时溺水人数也上升，两者相关；但冰淇淋不一定导致溺水。更可能的共同原因是气温升高：天气热，人们买更多冰淇淋，也更常去游泳。判断因果不能只看同时变化，还要排除共同原因、反向因果和巧合，最好通过控制变量或随机实验观察：只改变是否吃冰淇淋，其他条件尽量相同，再比较溺水风险。
answers.d08: Compound growth means each period’s increase is added to the amount that will grow next period. If $100 grows by 10% yearly, after two years it is $100×1.1²=$121, not $120, because the second year also earns on the first year’s increase. In general, final amount = starting amount×(1+growth rate)^periods. The starting amount matters because every percentage increase is calculated from the current base: doubling the starting amount doubles the final amount when the rate and time are unchanged. A larger rate or longer period also has a powerful effect because the factor is repeatedly multiplied.
answers.v01: 过拟合是模型把训练数据记得太细，连其中的噪声和偶然规律也当成真正规律。比如学生把练习题答案背下来，换一种题型就不会做；模型在训练集上分数很高，但在新数据上表现差。原因通常是模型过于复杂、数据太少或训练太久。判断过拟合要比较训练集和未见过的验证集：训练好、验证差，说明泛化不足。增加数据、限制模型复杂度、正则化或提前停止，都可能改善它。
answers.v02: Suppose a search system returns 10 results, and 6 of them are actually relevant. There are 8 relevant items in the entire collection. Precision asks: “Of what we returned, how many were relevant?” So precision=6/10=60%. Recall asks: “Of everything relevant, how much did we find?” So recall=6/8=75%. Precision penalizes irrelevant results; recall penalizes missed relevant results. Returning only one highly relevant result may give high precision but low recall. Returning almost everything may raise recall while lowering precision. The right balance depends on the search task.
answers.v03: 自然选择改变种群，是因为同一种群中本来就有可遗传的差异，而且不同差异会影响生存和繁殖成功率。比如一群甲虫中，绿色和棕色个体都存在；在棕色树皮上，鸟更难发现棕色甲虫，于是它们平均留下更多后代。经过多代，棕色特征在种群中的比例上升。甲虫不是因为“想变棕”或主动努力才改变；个体的变异先存在，环境再使某些变异更容易传下去。环境改变时，优势特征也可能改变。
answers.v04: Idempotency means that repeating the same operation has the same final effect as performing it once. For example, setting an account’s status to “active” is idempotent: sending the request three times still leaves it active. Adding $10 to a balance is not idempotent: retries could add $30. In distributed systems, requests may be retried after timeouts even when the server already processed them. Idempotency keys, unique request IDs, or “set” operations let the server recognize duplicates and avoid unintended repeated effects. It does not mean every retry returns an identical response; it means the relevant state does not keep changing.
answers.v05: 信息熵衡量的是结果出现前的不确定程度。对概率为p_i的结果，熵为H=−Σp_i log₂p_i，单位通常是比特。抛一枚公平硬币，正反各1/2，熵为1比特；若硬币几乎总是正面，结果容易猜，熵就低。均匀分布通常更不确定，因为在没有额外信息时，每个可能结果都同样有机会，无法靠偏好的结果减少猜测范围。例如四个等可能选项的熵为2比特；若其中一个概率接近1，熵会下降。这里的“不确定”是概率意义，不是主观觉得困难。
answers.v06: Deadlock occurs when processes wait for one another forever. Example: Process A holds Resource 1 and waits for Resource 2; Process B holds Resource 2 and waits for Resource 1. Neither can continue or release what it holds, so both remain stuck. This is different from ordinary waiting: the wait forms a cycle. Deadlock generally requires four conditions: exclusive resources, holding while waiting, no forced taking-away, and circular waiting. Breaking any one condition can prevent it—for example, require every process to request resources in a fixed global order.
answers.v07: 公共物品有两个特点：一个人使用不容易减少别人使用的机会，而且很难把不付费的人排除在外。路灯、国防通常属于这类物品。搭便车是指一个人享受公共物品，却希望别人承担成本。例如居民都希望街道有路灯，但每个人都可能想“别人交钱就好”。如果大家都这样想，公共物品就会供给不足。因此现实中常由税收或共同规则筹资。公共物品并非“免费生产”，只是使用者难以单独承担或被排除。
answers.v08: Little’s law connects three long-run averages in a stable queue: L = λW. L is the average number of items in the system, λ is the average arrival rate, and W is the average time an item spends in the system. If a service receives 10 requests per minute and each request stays in the system for 2 minutes on average, then L=10×2=20 requests on average. The “system” must be defined consistently, such as including both waiting and service. The law does not require a particular arrival pattern or service distribution, but it assumes the system is stable over the period measured.
